description: Complete workflow for clipping podcasts/long-form into viral short-form

methods.name: Manual watching
methods.description: Watch podcast, note timestamps of viral moments

methods.name: YouTube transcript search
methods.description: Ctrl+F in YouTube transcript to find keywords
methods.keywords_to_search: Keywords from comments, intro/trailer, or description
methods.example: Search 'flirting' in Caleb Hammer podcast transcript

methods.name: Comments scraping
methods.description: Check YouTube comments for timestamps people highlight
methods.note: If people comment on it, it's likely viral material

methods.name: AI detection
methods.description: Use tools like Way in Video to auto-detect viral moments
methods.output: Scores each clip with viral score, ranks them
methods.example: Way in Video found 41 viral moments from one podcast

criteria: Has a strong hook in first 2 seconds

step_3_edit_clip.tool: CapCut (primary), Way in Video, Opus Clip
steps: 3. Trim ALL boring/silent parts (cut every 2-3 seconds)
9. Add sound effects at key moments

caption_rules.colors: White text with dark outline or background

step_4_post_and_track.hashtag_strategy: Use relevant hashtags, tag original creator

doubling_down.method: When a clip goes viral (1M+ views), make 3 variations
doubling_down.result: Same clip can generate 2-5M+ total views across versions

step_5_batch_system.friday_30min: Find ideas/clips to clip (save viral templates)
step_5_batch_system.saturday: Batch download + trim into segments (7-15 clips)
step_5_batch_system.daily_3min: Post one clip per day from batch

tools_mentioned.way_in_video: AI viral moment detection + auto reframe
